description: Drama Studio writers room: turn a one-line premise into a short-drama season: a character bible (1-4 original fictional characters: name, role, look) and 2-8 episode scripts, each with a title, a logline, a script and a "cliffhangerLine". The cliffhanger is SPOKEN: the script's last sentence is exactly "cliffhangerLine" (an open hook for every episode but the last; a payoff plus one lingering question for the last), the first sentence is a hook and the next episode picks the hook up. Each script is already sized to pass quote_character_episode (12-60 seconds of narration); an episode that could not be made to fit comes back with needsEditing: true and the exact limit in `issue`. FREE: it spends no credits, starts nothing and saves nothing (it is limited per hour). Characters are fictional adults (or animals / mascots), AI-generated: no real or famous people, no children or anyone who looks under 18, no sexual content, no logos or protected characters (refused with CONTENT_POLICY, nothing charged). Everything made here is AI-generated and labelled as such. Next steps: create_series (startPaused: true; its name is only a label), create_character_sheet with the main character as `description` (show the human the price first), then save_season_plan (the whole season: cast, voice, style, every episode), review it, get the human's yes and confirm it; only then quote_character_episode and create_character_episode per episode. Requires the "video:read" scope.

genre.description: drama, thriller, comedy, horror or romance.

language.description: Language code of the scripts, such as 'en' or 'vi'. Default 'en'.

premise.description: The story in one to three sentences: who, what they want, what goes wrong.
